facts.fact: The state company SNDI organised the 21-22 July 2026 seminar and is deploying the interoperability platform for the administration, whose pilot phase covers 12 public bodies; the platform itself is stated to be available (Fraternite Matin, 2026-07-23).

systems.country_label: Plateforme d'interoperabilite des systemes d'information de l'administration (UXP)
